newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume fell at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Turnover shrank to 61,610 denars from 378,370 at the previous session on January 14 and traded volume fell to 61 shares from 357.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold 61 shares at 1,010 denars, down 20 from last trading and below par of 2,423 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
